approved_customer_facts.text: Xero software is included in the advertised monthly Simbian prices (Comply £29.99, Growth £59.99, Elite £89.99, VAT included). Customers do not pay separately for their included Xero licence. Website catalogue mapping: Comply→Xero Simple, Growth→Xero Ignite, Elite→Xero Grow.

TaxSimba maintains clients’ digital bookkeeping records within agreed package limits. Numerical/transaction limits for Comply, Growth and Elite remain UNDECIDED — do not invent caps or promise unlimited bookkeeping.
Quarterly MTD updates and year-end Self Assessment preparation and submission are included in all three Simbian packages, subject to documented customer responsibilities (timely records/information).
Support is through approved email and client-dashboard messaging channels, not telephone onboarding.
The £99 consultation is a 30-minute accountant advice session via Google Meet. It excludes tax return filing, bookkeeping and written reports.
